museum.onchain.title: 6529 Network Museum on Ethereum (preview)
museum.onchain.description: An unlinked test that reads the 6529 Network Museum from a ProvenanceRegistry contract on the Sepolia test network and shows each record only after its bytes match the chain.
museum.onchain.notice: Test preview, read from a Sepolia test registry and IPFS. Not the Museum's record on Ethereum mainnet.

museum.onchain.intro: Every work, artist, record and text below was fetched from IPFS and shown only after its hash matched the one the Museum stored in a test registry on Ethereum's Sepolia network.

museum.onchain.verification.heading: How this is checked
museum.onchain.verification.lead: Each record is a JSON document in the 6529 provenance profile, version 1. The page reads the record's IPFS content ID and Keccak-256 hash from the registry contract, fetches the record by that content ID, writes it out in the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785), hashes the result with Keccak-256, and shows the record only if the two hashes are equal.

museum.onchain.verification.subjects: It then checks that the record is the one the registry filed it under. The subject ID must be the Keccak-256 of the record's namespace, record type and local ID, as in 6529networkmuseum.subject.prv_entity.v1:6529NM-W-0001, and the record type, schema and effective time must match the registry's.
museum.onchain.verification.texts: A text is a PRV_DOCUMENT record that names the text by content ID, SHA-256 and size. The page fetches the text and shows it only if its SHA-256 and size match the record.
museum.onchain.verification.images: Images come from the file index the release names by content ID. Your browser fetches each image and shows it only after its SHA-256 matches the index.
